parameters.content:
## Tags are a data model nobody designed
GHL accumulated 57 tags doing four different jobs at once:
lifecycle state, lead source, cohort membership and audience
lists. Migrated as-is they become 57 unexplained labels, so each
one is classified and given a recommended action.

nodes.name: 1. Tags are a data model nobody designed

parameters.content:
## Classify each tag and say what to do with it
A cohort tag such as 'registered splunk bootcamp jan-2026'
should become a cohort record, not a label. A lifecycle tag such
as 'hot lead' is already an opportunity stage. Saying so in the
record is what stops the same argument happening twice.

nodes.name: 2. Classify each tag and say what to do with it

parameters.content:
## Write the decision down
The classification lands on the tag record itself, so the
migration decision travels with the thing it is about instead of
living in someone's notes.

meta.description: Daily. Keeps the crmTag catalogue in step with the tags actually in use and flags the ones that should become fields or be dropped. GHL's 57 tags were carrying state no object owned.
